variable(
    __list__(Type.annotation(@P, Set(T)), Type.annotation(@$\lt$, Rl(P, P))),structure(
    Set.order.partial(P, $\lt$),
    __enum__(
        Logic.forall-typed(@p, P, Logic.neg(Rl.apply($\lt$, p, p))),
        Logic.forall-typed(@q, P, Logic.forall-typed(@r, P, Logic.forall-typed(@s, P, Logic.implies(Logic.and(Rl.apply($\lt$, q, r), Rl.apply($\lt$, r, s)), Rl.apply($\lt$, q, s)))))
    )
))
